notes: Account: Meridian SupportGrid — mid-market SaaS (internal IT helpdesk product for distributed customers).
Context: Product + IT teams evaluating Redwood to replace a brittle rules-based bot and reduce MTTR for internal ticketing.
Initial interest: Hosted API for quick POC -> likely move to Dedicated if latency and audit controls meet SLOs.
Primary workload: internal IT/helpdesk chat assisting employees (password resets, app access, triage) with tool-calling to ServiceNow/Jira and live diagnostics.
Latency requirements: p50 ~40-80ms, p95 target <150ms for short turn-taking flows (must-support streaming). Customer emphasized "fast, conversational handoffs".
POC plan: 2-week hosted API POC (completed week 1), measure streaming token latency, tool-calling reliability, audit log fidelity. Week 2: stress-run with synthetic concurrency (100–200 agents).

POC interim results: streaming enabled, observed p50 ~62ms, p95 ~185ms on hosted — good for prototypes but above customer's desired p95. Customer requested Dedicated baseline numbers + expected improvements from local KV cache and batching tuning.

Security ask: mandatory SSO/SAML, tenant-level audit logs for every user interaction, retention controls configurable per-channel (legal asked for 90d for HR flows). KMS integration mandatory for secrets + optional HSM for future private deployment.
Data residency: EU-sourced HR team needs EU region residency; product team fine with NA for general support. Asked about per-route routing policy.

Integration needs: function/tool calling to create tickets, enrich with device diagnostics (logs), run remote diag scripts via internal ops agent (only metadata passed to LLM), deterministic structured outputs for ticket fields.
Customization: wants ability to pin model versions, run canary rollouts for new prompts, and QA harness for regression on top-100 prompt set.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-25): "We need near-real-time turnaround for end-user flows or the team will reject the bot — latency is everything."
Operational concerns: cost sensitivity around high token volumes (internal chat peaks), requesting Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization) to stay within $/agent budgets.
Commercial: evaluating 12–24 month Dedicated commit if SLA/p95 improvements justify ~3x hosted cost; finance scheduled pricing review 2026-03-18.

Next tactical steps: Redwood to run Dedicated perf baseline (p50/p95) with same prompt set; provide sample config for per-route audit logging and retention; security team to share SOC2/ISO artifacts and KMS integration guide.
Open blockers captured in Jira: JIRA-INF-784 (audit-log schema questions), JIRA-SRV-912 (retention controls mapping for HR), awaiting legal redlines on DPA.
Meeting artifacts: Fireflies ff-20260225-7b9c (initial technical scoping), ff-20260302-1f3a (POC demo + feedback).
Internal stakeholders: CTO - Lena Park, Head of Ops - Marcus Doyle, Product Lead - Priya Nair. AE owner Maya Rhodes + SE Rina Patel handling demos. CSM Jorge Alvarez prepping onboarding options.
Sales notes: use-case maps well to Redwood strengths (streaming, function calling, rollout controls). Emphasize Dedicated performance, per-route audit logs, and Optimize recommendations in next demo.
